Cranking Fuel (Repeat Attempt, Special Start)
table.description:
Cranking fuel pulse by coolant for a repeat attempt in the special start type.
Coolant-indexed base of the cranking pulse FFF8AFC6 (0x0C9038, read); used when flag s4 (= TGV-module flag FFF8A881 bit 2, read) set, s8 set, FFF8A6E7 = 3 (s8 = FFF811A7 bit 7, the repeat-crank history; argument mapping read from the calls at 0x0C589C). Cranking pulse (read, 0x0C9038): FFF842C8 = clamp(base x 256 x A67E x A687 x C535 x coolant multiplier x 64 / (2^32 x 255), 0, 524280) x 0.125 (the 64 is fixed, folded into the constant 5.843592e-11; Cranking Fuel Secondary Low Rail Pressure Multiplier 05A1FC acts only on the secondary pulse in 0x0C8A28), and the per-injector quantity is never below 10 x that (0x0D168C), in 0.8 us counts. Raw units: the factors' normalisation is not fully resolved, so change it proportionally. FFF8AFC6 feeds injectors in fuel mode 0 or 3. LT8F300C: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (similarity port (code)). Confidence: inferred.

table.description:
Size of what appears to be a one-shot priming injection at key-on/cranking, by coolant; the pulse is proportional to it.
Details: When used: only if cal 0x28D98 = 1 or 2. 0x0CD4AC (read): FFF8A67D = this(coolant FFF8CD65 = degC + 50) during key-on and cranking (fuel state 1/2), held afterwards. 0x0CD500 / 0x0CD5DC compute the pulses FFF8C040 / FFF8C044 = 05A8F4 / 05A908(rail pressure FFF89266, FFF8A652) x flow compensation FFF8AFEA x barometric factor FFF8A687 x FFF8A67D x 2^-18 x 1.25 + latency, and 0x1D296C fires each of them once per injector (flags FFF8C6F4-C6F7) when cal 0x28D98 = 1 or 2 (read): a one-shot priming injection at start (inferred). The pulse is proportional to this value. LT8F300C: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (similarity port (code)). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Running After-Start Enrichment 1 (Special Start)
table.description:
Running After-Start Enrichment 1 for the special start type, which is disabled by calibration.
Details: When used: start type FFF8A6E7 = 3 or above, in fuel states 2 (cranking) and 3 (running). Amount E1 (1/256 of fuel) for this start type, on coolant FFF88A44. 0x0CDD8C (read) builds FFF8B010: three amounts E1/E2/E3, each from a coolant table chosen by start type FFF8A6E7 (0 first start, 1 restart after key-off, 2 restart after stall, else special start; type and coolant FFF88A44 latched when fuel state 2/3 is entered (start of cranking, or a return from 3 to 2) for the amounts E1-E3, and latched again when fuel state 3 is entered (end of cranking) for the decay tables D1-D3), each faded linearly to zero over 8 x D passes of FFF8B06A (passes since fuel state 3, 0x0D1354) by its own decay table D1/D2/D3 (factor = clamp((8D - FFF8B06A) x 32 / D, 0, 255) / 256; no fade while cranking); FFF8B010 = max(E1, E2, E3) x 05AA60(rpm)/128 x FFF8A696/128 + Low Rail Pressure Start Enrichment, forced to 0 at load FFF8A616 >= cal 0x237C8 (255, hysteresis cal 0x237C9) and outside fuel states 2/3. FFF8B010 is summed with Warm-Up Enrichment FFF8B030 in the enrichment term of the fuel factor 0x0C558C (read), blocks long-term trim learning (0x0FFE40) and is read by the closed-loop controller 0x0FD76C. This is the running-path counterpart of After-Start Enrichment 1-3 (0x0CD834 -> FFF8B012, start path). LT8F300C: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (similarity port (code)). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Start Injection Angle (Stop-Start Restart, Low Rail Pressure)
table.description:
Injection angle while cranking for a stop-start restart with rail pressure below 2 MPa. Stop-start cannot activate in this calibration, so probably unused. Not clamped by the ECU: keep it within 0.5-180 BTDC. Edit with the High Rail Pressure table.
Details: When used: while cranking (fuel state FFF8906B = 2) with the stop-start restart request FFF89066 bit 0 set and rail pressure FFF88884 below cal 0x2A65E (3279 = 2.0 MPa / 290 psi) (0x0CFB28, called from 0x0C589C with (906B, coolant FFF88A44, rpm/50, cal 0x38448 bit 7, FFF89066 bit 0, FFF88884, &FFF8B050, &FFF8B008), args read in the caller's disassembly). Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the injected cylinder's compression TDC (720 - code/2; larger = earlier), same scale as every injection-angle table (my research notes). It replaces Start Injection Angle (Fuel Mode 0) in FFF8B050, which 0x0CB394 uses as the first-pulse angle of injectors in fuel mode 0 (segment 3, offset B050 - 1080) (read). Unlike that table it is only floored at code 0, not clamped to 1080-1439, so keep it within 180-0.5 BTDC (code 1080-1439) (read). Setting cal 0x38448 bit 7 would force cal 0x11EBC (clamped to 1080-1439) instead. FFF89066 bit 0 = CAN 0x15A byte 2 bit 0, the restart request of the engine stop-start feature (signals_rates_can.md, my research notes, read). Edit with the High Rail Pressure table. LT8F300C: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (similarity port (code)). Confidence: inferred.

Only floored at code 0, not clamped (read): keep it within 180-0.5 BTDC (code 1080-1439). FFF89066 bit 0 = CAN 0x15A byte 2 bit 0, the restart request of the engine stop-start feature (signals_rates_can.md, my research notes, read). table.description:
Base intake cam 1 valve duty by rpm for an older, byte-based cam control path.
Base term by rpm of the intake cam 1 OCV duty in the legacy byte-based AVCS path: about 49.2-52.0 % duty before the FFF88AA4 factor; the learned and feedback bytes are added around 128 (= 51.2 %). Module (read): seg 0x100000 0x104xxx-0x106xxx is the byte-based cam path; 0x10466C (intake, called at seg_0x100000.c:3516 with rpm CD54, FFF88AA4, learned bytes FFF8147A/147C/147E, feedback bytes FFF8B368, cam errors B956/B954) forms per cam: B352 = this(rpm) x 026EB0/026EC0(FFF88AA4)/128; B356 = 147A if the cam error >= cal 0x26E82 (364 = 2.0 deg), 147C if <= cal 0x26E84 (-2.0 deg), else 128; B366 = clamp(B368 + B352 + 147E + B356 - 384, 0, 250). 0x106A0C does the same for the exhaust cams (05CF08/05CF14, factors 0298F4/029904, errors B916/B914, thresholds cal 0x298C6/0x298C8) into B380. table.description:

Details: When used: TGVs not closed and multi-injection active (FFF8A775 bit 1); cal 0x2F797 bit 5 clear. Target EGR rate (0x0FA260, read): FFF8A81A = base A817 x Coolant Multiplier 05CB04/255 x 255/255 (A816) x Reduction Multiplier A81C/255 x DAM Multiplier 05CB10/128, x 640 (1/640 units), capped at cal 0x2C4E6 (192 = 30 %) and forced to 0 unless the enable conditions FFF8A811 bit 0 hold (0x0FAAFC).
